description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git revision listing and formatting functionalities. It contains test setup procedures, various test cases for format options, color output, encoding, and other features related to git rev-list command output formatting.

methods.name: test_format
methods.description: Function to test different formats of 'git rev-list' output with specified format strings.

methods.name: test_pretty
methods.description: Function to test pretty formatting options for 'git rev-list' output.

methods.name: has_color
methods.description: Checks if the output contains color escape sequences indicating colored output.

methods.name: has_no_color
methods.description: Checks if the output does not contain color escape sequences.
